False Breakouts: Read the Reaction, Not Just the Wick

A false breakout can occur when price moves beyond a level and then returns back inside the area. Instead of reacting to one candle, study the close, follow-through, and what happens next. A single wick is information, not proof. Waiting for confirmation can reduce impulsive decisions, while still leaving room for the market to surprise you.

TRADING IS NOT FOR THOSE WHO DON'T HAVE PATIENCE.  LEARN | TRADE | EARN
